items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Nexuhi is a very nice guy.

ctx.x: He told some cats one day, I was in the office and he said, he's my best friend, and pointed to me, you know.
Nexuhi is a very nice guy.
He sure has been nice to us. He's been wonderful oh...... Now we haven't heard from him for about ......
